Thanks Lauren - good recap. Confirming a few items from FinPay's side:

- Deployment: We are leaning toward Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem hybrid) to keep control-plane traffic inside our networking boundaries where possible.
- Auth: Security prefers mTLS for control-plane + mutual auth for webhooks; for application-to-Redwood they want service account credentials with short-lived tokens via our internal OIDC provider.
- Networking constraints: We must only allow egress to a fixed set of IPs for control-plane calls, and we will publish DNS records internally for any private endpoints.
- Embeddings / reranker: We'll likely start with embedding-based semantic search for customer support (initial batch ~10M documents). We also need a recommended approach for reranking (approx latency target 150-200ms for top-K).

I've attached our network contact list and a short internal requirements PDF. Carlos (cc'd) will be the main infra contact for the technical sync. He prefers Wed morning PST.

Hi Sarah - Jonas from infra here. Quick technical notes and a sample config to prep for the sync. Short version below, details follow in the attached snippet.

1) Control-plane options - If you run Redwood Private with a customer-managed control plane, we can support private endpoints (DNS entries in your VPC) and mTLS mutual auth between your network and our control-plane instances.
- For mTLS: we recommend ECDSA P-256 certs, 1 year max validity, and automated rotation via your internal PKI/ACME pipeline.

2) IP allowlist / egress - We will provide a stable set of egress IPs for control-plane callbacks. Recommend implementing a dedicated NAT gateway/Subnet for Redwood egress and allowlist the provided IP block on your firewall.
- If you have strict egress rules, consider a proxy appliance to centralize TLS termination and forwarding.

3) DNS and VPC endpoints - Create private hosted zone entries (Route53 private zone) that resolve to the VPC endpoint ENIs we expose. Ensure your VPC DNS resolution + query logging enabled for troubleshooting.

4) SDK & auth - SDK will support both token-based and mTLS client cert options. Example commands (from attached): curl with client cert and a Python SDK snippet for OIDC token exchange and short-lived credential usage.

5) Embeddings / reranker guidance - For ~10M docs: recommend incremental ingestion to embeddings store, use 1536-d embeddings with FAISS/HNSW index and a lightweight reranker model for top-50 -> top-5 rerank. We can provide a throughput/latency profile and batching guidance to meet 150-200ms tail.

Attached: lauren-finpay-vpc-snippet.txt (sample NAT/route, DNS, curl/sdk examples). Looking forward to the sync Wed 2026-07-13 09:00 PST.
